name: Open Science Framework(OSF)
storage_type: Data repository for project management and data publication
purpose: Project management interface which also integrates with external storage solutions and supports adding licenses, a DOI and file metadata to files and folders.
collaboration: Project can be private or public. Private projects can only be viewed and edited by project members. Public projects can be viewed by anyone and edited by project members. You can also create a private URL.
capacity: 5 GB for private projects, 50 GB for public projects. If you need more you can store data in an external, supported solution and link that solution to your OSF project.

name: U-drive and O-drive
purpose: Standard service for UU staff and students for storing and sharing files. O-Drive: common storage for faculties, services and departments. U- Drive: Personal storage for UU staff and students.
access: Desktops at UU have the drives automatically available. Outside of the UU network, you can use VPN (vpn.uu.nl) to have a local copy of your U/O-drive cached to your device, or use SolisWorkspace (https://manuals.uu.nl/en/a-z/?_tags=solisworkspace)
collaboration:
U-drive: no
O-drive: internal sharing only (university access)
capacity:
U Drive: 0.1 TB (extension possible on request via ITS Servicedesk)
O-Drive: Unlimited
profile_text:

name: UU Sharepoint & Microsoft Teams
purpose: Microsoft Teams is part of Office 365 and offers an integrated collaboration environment. Store and share files with your team, edit documents with multiple people at the same time, chat with your colleagues, schedule online video calls, organize live events and make use of extra tools like a Wiki or Planner. Files in a Teams environment can also be accessed via Sharepoint. Teamsire Extra Secure is similair to a regular Teamsite, but more closed. For example it’s not possible to synchronize files locally or to share files with external people.
access: Accessible from anywhere with internet access and institutional login via the browser, Teams application or OneDrive client.
collaboration: Internal and external sharing (through email address). Teamsite Secure can only be shared internally.
capacity:
